title: The Four Buckets of Income: Why Wages Cap Your Life

beats.say: Every single dollar you earn falls into four buckets, and three guarantee you'll always trade time for cash.
beats.visual: Low angle silhouette of a lone worker standing under harsh flickering sodium lights at an empty subway terminal at night.

beats.say: First, you're an employee, selling hours directly to a boss for a fixed wage.
beats.visual: High angle wide shot of a glass skyscraper silhouetted against cold blue hour fog.

beats.say: Second, you're self-employed, but if you stop working, your revenue stops instantly.
beats.visual: Close-up of rain-slicked dark pavement reflecting red taillights outside a quiet night shop.

beats.say: Third, you're a business owner with employees, but managing them still requires your daily presence.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary figure walking past massive brutalist concrete pillars under an overpass.

beats.say: Most people think getting ahead requires working longer shifts or taking on a second job.
beats.visual: Cold fluorescent light cutting through a dark industrial hallway, fog lingering near the ceiling.

beats.say: But your time is finite, meaning your active income will always hit a hard ceiling.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive steel bridge structure towering into a shadowy night sky.

beats.say: That brings us to bucket four: owning income-generating assets that work while you sleep.
beats.visual: Single practical desk light illuminating a dark quiet room, extreme low angle.

beats.say: So how much capital does it actually take to buy back your full freedom?
beats.visual: Silhouette standing on a high tower edge looking out over a foggy skyline at dawn.

beats.say: To generate $2,000 a month in passive income, you need about $600,000 invested.
beats.visual: Dark open water at twilight with distant harbour lights reflecting on wet dark waves.

beats.say: Investing $1,000 a month at 8% a year reaches that target in 20.2 years.
beats.visual: Extreme wide, empty highway stretching into midnight fog with a single streetlight cutting through mist.

beats.say: Moving your cash from active labor into automated assets breaks the hourly trap forever.
beats.visual: Wet asphalt at blue hour reflecting muted sodium lights, wide cinematic angle.

beats.say: Build systems instead of trading hours. Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Silhouette on a ridge line looking toward a massive city skyline slowly glowing at blue hour.

caption:
Trading time for money has a built-in ceiling. Here is how asset ownership changes the math.
